producer_report.summary: `athena status` and `status --snapshot` now print, for the newest five landed jobs, each stage's minutes and main reason. The stages are queue wait, reading, each planning round, producer, checks, verifier, landing and disk wait. Reasons are model and effort, tokens, turns, commands run, retries, compile and lint check time against test time, the slowest check and the build-slot wait. A time or reason with no record prints `not recorded`, never zero. Disk wait always prints `not recorded`, because no record holds it. I also fixed the landing figure, which the real snapshot showed at hundreds of minutes: it now uses the oldest landing record that names the job, not the newest. That gives 16–18 min per job and a median of 18.0 min, against 1325 before. That is still more than "a few minutes", and I did not compare it with git commit times for each landing. Tests pass for `athena-core` and `athena-cli`, the policy scan passes, and clippy is clean. CHANGELOG.md has a new entry and docs/decisions.md has D187.

open_issues: Landing is 16-18 min per job on the real records, not 'a few minutes': it runs from the verifier's end to the oldest landing record, which is written after CI wait and merge. I did not compare it with git commit times for each landing.
Disk wait always prints 'not recorded': no record holds it. Queue wait is measured from the accepted reading to dispatch.
Checks show 'test 0.0 min' for jobs whose checks are fails-without-N runs; the test check was not run by name in those records.
mistakes: An early draft labelled planner plus critic pairs as 'retries'; fixed to label retries only when one role repeats.
learnings: Each landing record under landings/ re-lists earlier job landings, so taking the newest record for a job inflated the landing stage to hundreds of minutes; the oldest record gives 16-18 min.
status_snapshot.rs asserted no job id appears in snapshot output; the new per-stage section prints job ids, so that assertion now excludes lines starting 'stages '.
The cli and core test suites take about 7 and 9 minutes.
desires: A way to read git commit times for a landed job from the evidence history by job id, to check landing time against git precisely.
